senses.en: behaving in a polite, proper and dignified way

example.en: The guests kept decorous silence during the ceremony.
example.zh: 宾客们在仪式期间保持了得体的安静。

senses.en: to make movements with your hands or arms to express something
senses.zh: 用手势表达；（激动地）打手势

example.en: The taxi driver gesticulated wildly at the driver who cut him off.
example.zh: 出租车司机朝别他的司机狂打手势。

senses.en: to cause a place to lose most of its population

example.en: War and famine depopulated the region.
example.zh: 战争和饥荒使该地区人口锐减。

senses.en: to make something magnetic

example.en: The experiment showed how iron can be magnetized.
example.zh: 这个实验展示了铁可以被磁化。

senses.en: to make something weaker or impure by adding inferior substances

example.en: Some sellers adulterate olive oil with cheaper oils.
example.zh: 一些卖家在橄榄油中掺入较便宜的油。

senses.en: the sport of riding on a skateboard

example.en: Skateboarding became an Olympic sport in 2021.
example.zh: 滑板运动于2021年成为奥运会比赛项目。

senses.en: death (formal or legal term)

example.en: The estate was divided after his decease.
example.zh: 他去世后遗产被分割了。

senses.en: (archaic or legal) to die

example.en: He deceased without leaving a will.
example.zh: 他去世时未留下遗嘱。

senses.en: new and experimental ideas and methods in art

example.en: The gallery shows works from the avant-garde.
example.zh: 这家美术馆展出先锋派的作品。

senses.en: radically new and experimental, especially in art

example.en: She enjoys avant-garde films and music.
example.zh: 她喜欢先锋电影和音乐。

senses.en: a person who gives information, especially to researchers or police
senses.zh: 提供消息的人；（给警方提供线索的）告密者

example.en: The journalist relied on a confidential informant.
example.zh: 这名记者依靠一位保密的消息提供者。

senses.en: a place where two roads cross

example.en: Turn left at the crossroads and go straight for two kilometers.
example.zh: 在十字路口左转，然后直行两公里。

senses.en: a point in life or history when an important decision must be made

example.en: After ten years abroad, she found herself at a crossroads in her career.
example.zh: 在国外十年后，她发现自己正处于职业生涯的十字路口。

senses.en: directed or located toward the source of a river or stream

example.en: The pollution came from an upstream factory.
example.zh: 污染来自上游的一家工厂。

senses.en: toward the source of a river or against the current

example.en: The boat drifted slowly upstream.
example.zh: 船缓慢地逆流而上。

senses.en: Words that express approval or admiration for someone or something.
senses.zh: 表达赞许或钦佩的话语；称赞

example.en: Her teacher gave her high praise for the essay.
example.zh: 老师对她的文章给予了高度赞扬。

senses.en: To express approval or admiration for someone or something.

example.en: The coach praised the team for their effort.
example.zh: 教练称赞了队员们的努力。

senses.en: Words or songs that honor a god as an act of worship.

example.en: The congregation sang songs of praise.
example.zh: 会众唱起了赞美诗。

senses.en: valuable and worth a lot of money

example.en: She keeps her precious jewels in a safe.
example.zh: 她把贵重的珠宝放在保险箱里。

senses.en: loved or treasured very much

example.en: Time with family is precious to me.
example.zh: 与家人共度的时光对我很珍贵。

senses.en: very; extremely (used before adjectives, informal)

example.en: The box was precious little help.
example.zh: 这个盒子几乎没什么帮助。

senses.en: to rescue someone or something from harm or danger

example.en: The firefighters saved the family from the burning house.
example.zh: 消防员把一家人从着火的房子里救了出来。

senses.en: to keep money or something else for future use

example.en: She saves part of her salary every month.
example.zh: 她每个月把一部分工资存起来。

senses.en: an act of stopping the opposing team from scoring in sports

example.en: The goalkeeper made a fine save in the final minute.
example.zh: 守门员在最后一分钟完成了一次漂亮的扑救。

senses.en: an action or step taken to achieve a goal

example.en: The government introduced new measures to reduce traffic.
example.zh: 政府推出了减少车流量的新措施。

senses.en: to find the size, amount, or degree of something

example.en: She measured the room before buying furniture.
example.zh: 她买家具前量了房间的尺寸。

senses.en: a unit or standard used to express size or amount

example.en: The meter is a measure of length.
example.zh: 米是长度的计量单位。

senses.en: (biology) a group of living things whose members can breed with each other

example.en: The park protects several endangered species.
example.zh: 这座公园保护着几种濒危物种。

senses.en: a particular kind of thing

example.en: She had to deal with a different species of problem.
example.zh: 她不得不处理一种不同的问题。

senses.en: to come out into view, especially from behind something or from water
senses.zh: 出现；浮现（尤指从隐蔽处或水中）

example.en: A small boat emerged from the fog.
example.zh: 一艘小船从雾中显现出来。

senses.en: to become known or apparent

example.en: New details emerged during the investigation.
example.zh: 调查期间出现了新的细节。

senses.en: to come into existence or develop

example.en: A new market emerged for electric bicycles.
example.zh: 电动自行车的新市场形成了。

senses.en: a person who prepares and decides the final content of a text, newspaper, or magazine

example.en: The editor checked the article before publication.
example.zh: 编辑在文章发表前检查了文章。

senses.en: a computer program for creating or changing text or data

example.en: She opened the file in a text editor.
example.zh: 她用文本编辑器打开了文件。

senses.en: a person who cuts and arranges film or sound

example.en: The film editor shortened the opening scene.
example.zh: 电影剪辑师缩短了开场镜头。

senses.en: accurate or true; without mistakes

example.en: The teacher marked the answer as correct.
example.zh: 老师把那个答案判为正确。

senses.en: to make something right or fix an error

example.en: Please correct any mistakes in the report before Friday.
example.zh: 请在周五前改正报告中的任何错误。

senses.en: suitable or proper in a social situation

example.en: It is not correct to speak that way to a guest.
example.zh: 那样对客人说话是不合适的。

senses.en: connected with God or religion and treated with great respect

example.en: The temple is a holy site for pilgrims.
example.zh: 这座寺庙是朝圣者的圣地。

senses.en: morally pure and devoted to God

example.en: She lived a holy life devoted to helping others.
example.zh: 她过着圣洁的生活，致力于帮助他人。

senses.en: a fixed expression whose meaning differs from the literal meanings of its words

example.en: "Break the ice" is an idiom meaning to start a conversation.
example.zh: “打破沉默”（break the ice）是一个习语，意思是开始交谈。

senses.en: the characteristic style or way of expression of a language, group, or person
senses.zh: 语言风格；（某群体特有的）表达方式

example.en: She writes in the idiom of modern jazz.
example.zh: 她用现代爵士乐的语言风格进行创作。

senses.en: to slow down the progress or development of something

example.en: Cold weather can retard the growth of plants.
example.zh: 寒冷的天气会延缓植物的生长。

senses.en: to delay or slow the movement of something

example.en: The brakes retarded the train's speed.
example.zh: 刹车使火车的速度减慢了。

senses.en: (slang, offensive) a word for a person with an intellectual disability; extremely insulting and should be avoided
senses.zh: （俚语，冒犯）智力障碍者；极具侮辱性，应避免使用

example.en: This word is considered a slur and should not be used.
example.zh: 这个词被视为侮辱性词语，不应使用。

senses.en: to make something as large or effective as possible
senses.zh: 使最大化；使增加到最大限度

example.en: The company wants to maximize its profits this year.
example.zh: 公司想在今年实现利润最大化。

senses.en: not known or not experienced with something

example.en: The city streets were unfamiliar to the new driver.
example.zh: 新司机对这些城市街道不熟悉。

senses.en: the day of the week after Wednesday and before Friday

example.en: We have a team meeting every Thursday.
example.zh: 我们每周四开团队会议。

senses.en: the side sheltered from the wind

example.en: We anchored in the lee of the island.
example.zh: 我们在岛的背风处抛锚。

senses.en: located on or toward the side away from the wind

example.en: The ship was driven onto the lee shore by the gale.
example.zh: 船被大风刮向下风岸。

senses.en: the eleventh month of the year, between October and December (abbreviation of November)

example.en: My birthday is in Nov.
example.zh: 我的生日在十一月。

senses.en: to make someone feel shocked and disgusted

example.en: The cruelty of the act sickened the whole community.
example.zh: 这一残忍行为令整个社区感到震惊厌恶。

senses.en: to become ill

example.en: Many workers sickened after exposure to the fumes.
example.zh: 许多工人接触烟雾后生了病。

senses.en: to disturb or embarrass someone

example.en: Nothing seems to faze her, even in a crisis.
example.zh: 即使在危机中，似乎也没什么能让她慌乱。

senses.en: a person who guards prisoners in a jail

example.en: The jailer locked the cell door at night.
example.zh: 狱卒晚上锁上了牢房的门。

senses.en: a person who attacks someone physically

example.en: The police are searching for the assailant.
example.zh: 警方正在搜寻袭击者。

senses.en: a window set in a roof to let in light

example.en: Sunlight streamed through the skylight into the attic.
example.zh: 阳光透过天窗洒进阁楼。

senses.en: a tough plant fiber used to make rope, cloth and other products

example.en: The rope was made from strong hemp.
example.zh: 这根绳子是用结实的大麻纤维做的。

senses.en: the cannabis plant; some varieties are used as a drug
senses.zh: 大麻（植物；某些品种可作毒品）

example.en: Hemp and marijuana come from the same plant species.
example.zh: 工业大麻和大麻来自同一植物种类。

senses.en: a person honored for great achievement, especially a Nobel laureate or poet laureate

example.en: The Nobel laureate spoke at the university.
example.zh: 这位诺贝尔奖得主在大学发表了演讲。

senses.en: worthy of the highest honor; crowned with laurel

example.en: She was appointed poet laureate of the city.
example.zh: 她被任命为该市的桂冠诗人。

senses.en: used to refer to two or more people or things already mentioned
senses.zh: 指代已经提到的两个或两个以上的人或事物

example.en: They left their bags by the door.
example.zh: 他们把包留在了门边。

senses.en: used to refer to one person whose gender is unknown or not specified
senses.zh: 指代性别未知或未指定的人

example.en: Someone called, but they didn't leave a message.
example.zh: 有人打过电话，但没有留言。

senses.en: people in general, especially in phrases such as 'they say'
senses.zh: 人们；大家（尤用于 they say 等短语）

example.en: They say it will rain tomorrow.
example.zh: 人们说明天会下雨。

senses.en: at what time; used to ask about time

example.en: When does the meeting start?
example.zh: 会议什么时候开始？

senses.en: at or during the time that

example.en: Call me when you get home.
example.zh: 你到家时给我打电话。

senses.en: the time at which something happens

example.en: The plan explains the what, when, and how.
example.zh: 该计划说明了做什么、何时做以及如何做。

senses.en: the group of people who work for an organization

example.en: The hotel staff were friendly and helpful.
example.zh: 酒店员工友好且乐于助人。

senses.en: to provide the people who work at a place or event
senses.zh: 为…配备员工；担任…的工作人员

example.en: Volunteers staffed the information desk.
example.zh: 志愿者在咨询台值班。

senses.en: a strong stick used for walking or as a weapon

example.en: He leaned on a wooden staff.
example.zh: 他倚着一根木手杖。

senses.en: the five lines on which music is written

example.en: The notes are written on the staff.
example.zh: 音符写在五线谱上。

senses.en: used to say what is right or necessary to do
senses.zh: 应该；应当（表示义务或必要）

example.en: You ought to apologize.
example.zh: 你应该道歉。

senses.en: used to say what is likely or expected
senses.zh: 应该；想必（表示推测或预期）

example.en: The train ought to arrive soon.
example.zh: 火车应该快到了。

senses.en: a fight or serious disagreement between people or groups

example.en: The protest ended in a violent clash with the police.
example.zh: 抗议最终演变成与警察的激烈冲突。

senses.en: a loud noise like metal objects hitting each other

example.en: We heard the clash of swords in the distance.
example.zh: 我们听到远处传来的刀剑相击声。

senses.en: to disagree strongly or be incompatible

example.en: The two leaders often clash on economic policy.
example.zh: 这两位领导人经常在经济政策上发生分歧。

senses.en: to hit together loudly, or to look bad together (of colors)

example.en: The red shirt clashes with these green pants.
example.zh: 这件红衬衫和这条绿裤子不搭。

senses.en: a fortified building or place where soldiers stay and defend an area

example.en: The soldiers built a fort on the hill to guard the valley.
example.zh: 士兵们在山上修建了一座堡垒来守卫山谷。

senses.en: rough or made of large particles, not smooth or fine

example.en: The sand on this beach is coarse.
example.zh: 这片海滩上的沙子很粗糙。

senses.en: rude or lacking refinement

example.en: He made a coarse joke at the dinner table.
example.zh: 他在餐桌上讲了个粗俗的笑话。

senses.en: an item kept as a reminder of a place, event, or trip

example.en: She bought a small souvenir from the museum gift shop.
example.zh: 她在博物馆礼品店买了一件小纪念品。

senses.en: extreme and having a strong or sudden effect

example.en: The company took drastic measures to cut costs.
example.zh: 公司采取了削减成本的严厉措施。

senses.en: a long loud cry, especially of a wolf or dog

example.en: We heard the howl of a wolf in the distance.
example.zh: 我们听到远处传来狼的嗥叫声。

senses.en: to make a long loud cry like a wolf or dog

example.en: The wind howled through the trees all night.
example.zh: 风整夜在树间呼啸。

senses.en: to shout or laugh loudly in pain, anger or amusement

example.en: He howled with laughter at the joke.
example.zh: 他听了这个笑话放声大笑。

senses.en: a funny or satirical drawing, often in a newspaper or magazine

example.en: The newspaper publishes a political cartoon every morning.
example.zh: 这家报纸每天早上刊登一幅政治漫画。

senses.en: an animated film or TV program made with drawings

example.en: The kids love watching cartoons on Saturday mornings.
example.zh: 孩子们喜欢在周六早上看动画片。

senses.en: to draw cartoons of someone or something

example.en: The artist cartooned the mayor in yesterday's paper.
example.zh: 这位艺术家在昨天的报纸上把市长画成了漫画。

senses.en: money paid by a government to support a business, industry, or activity

example.en: The government gives farmers a subsidy to keep food prices low.
example.zh: 政府给农民发放补贴以保持食品价格低廉。

senses.en: to consist of or be made up of (specified parts)

example.en: The committee comprises five members.
example.zh: 该委员会由五名成员组成。

senses.en: to constitute or make up (a whole)

example.en: Women comprise the majority of the workforce.
example.zh: 女性构成了劳动力的大多数。

senses.en: a treatment or medicine that makes someone healthy again

example.en: Doctors are searching for a cure for this disease.
example.zh: 医生们正在寻找治愈这种疾病的方法。

senses.en: to make someone healthy again; to heal an illness

example.en: The new medicine cured her illness completely.
example.zh: 这种新药完全治好了她的病。

senses.en: to preserve food by drying, salting, or smoking it

example.en: They cure the ham by smoking it for weeks.
example.zh: 他们用熏制几个星期的方法来加工火腿。

senses.en: the outer edge of something round or circular

example.en: The cup has a small chip on its rim.
example.zh: 这个杯子的边缘有一处小缺口。

senses.en: in basketball, the metal ring that the net hangs from

example.en: His shot bounced off the rim.
example.zh: 他的投篮弹出了篮筐。

senses.en: a very strong feeling of dislike for someone or something

example.en: He spoke about his hatred of violence.
example.zh: 他谈到了自己对暴力的憎恨。

senses.en: an artificial waterway for boats or irrigation

example.en: The Panama Canal connects the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans.
example.zh: 巴拿马运河连接大西洋和太平洋。

senses.en: a tube or passage in the body

example.en: The doctor examined his ear canal.
example.zh: 医生检查了他的耳道。

senses.en: to provide a place with canals or make a waterway

example.en: The river was canalled to improve transport.
example.zh: 这条河被开凿成运河以改善运输。

senses.en: a building where weapons and military equipment are stored or made

example.en: The old arsenal was converted into a museum.
example.zh: 那座旧军械库被改造成了博物馆。

senses.en: the full range of weapons or resources available to someone
senses.zh: （全部）武器储备；（比喻）各种手段、工具

example.en: The team has a full arsenal of attacking players.
example.zh: 这支球队拥有一整套进攻型球员。

senses.en: in a clearly noticeable way

example.en: His health improved markedly after the treatment.
example.zh: 治疗后他的健康状况明显好转。

senses.en: the people from whom someone is descended; family line

example.en: She traced her ancestry back to Ireland.
example.zh: 她把自己的家世追溯到了爱尔兰。

senses.en: to cover something completely or thickly

example.en: She smothered the toast with butter.
example.zh: 她在吐司上涂了厚厚的黄油。

senses.en: to stop a fire from burning by covering it

example.en: They used a blanket to smother the small fire.
example.zh: 他们用毯子闷熄了小火。

senses.en: to suffocate or restrict someone's freedom, or to hide a feeling

example.en: He tried to smother his anger during the meeting.
example.zh: 他在开会时尽量压抑怒火。

senses.en: the spreading of a substance from an area of high concentration to one of low concentration

example.en: Diffusion causes the smell of perfume to spread through the room.
example.zh: 扩散使香水的气味弥漫整个房间。

senses.en: the spread of ideas, customs, or technologies between societies

example.en: The diffusion of smartphones changed daily life worldwide.
example.zh: 智能手机的普及改变了世界各地的日常生活。

senses.en: having a strong but often foolish or short-lived passion for someone

example.en: He was infatuated with his new colleague.
example.zh: 他迷恋着他的新同事。

senses.en: to make soil or land fertile, e.g. by adding fertilizer (British spelling)
senses.zh: 使肥沃；给……施肥（英式拼写）

example.en: Farmers fertilise the fields before planting.
example.zh: 农民在播种前给田地施肥。

senses.en: to make an egg or plant able to develop by joining it with male reproductive cells

example.en: The pollen fertilises the flower's egg cells.
example.zh: 花粉使花的卵细胞受精。

senses.en: able to read and write

example.en: Most adults in the country are literate.
example.zh: 该国大多数成年人都识字。

senses.en: having good knowledge of a particular subject, especially literature
senses.zh: 有文化修养的；精通文学的

example.en: She is literate in both music and literature.
example.zh: 她在音乐和文学方面都很有素养。

senses.en: friendly and welcoming to guests or strangers

example.en: The locals were very hospitable to the visitors.
example.zh: 当地人对外来客人非常热情好客。

senses.en: providing conditions suitable for life or growth

example.en: The soil is hospitable to many kinds of plants.
example.zh: 这种土壤适宜许多植物生长。

senses.en: a soft sedimentary rock formed in thin layers from clay and mud

example.en: Oil can be extracted from some types of shale.
example.zh: 某些类型的页岩中可以提取石油。

senses.en: to seriously injure someone, causing permanent damage to the body

example.en: The accident left him maimed and unable to work.
example.zh: 事故使他落下残疾，无法工作。

senses.en: a repeated design or regular arrangement

example.en: The fabric has a floral pattern.
example.zh: 这块布料有花卉图案。

senses.en: a regular way in which something happens or is done

example.en: Sleep patterns change as people get older.
example.zh: 睡眠模式会随年龄增长而改变。

senses.en: a model or guide for making something

example.en: She bought a pattern to sew a dress.
example.zh: 她买了一个纸样来做连衣裙。
